[[The Darkness (boss)|The Darkness]] is a type of [[demon]] that is part of the final challenge in the [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]], an [[elite]] [[explorable area]] that can only be reached after [[ascension|ascending]] in the [[Prophecies]] [[campaign]]. Three of these [[boss]]es defend a platform in the fourth room of ''Tombs'', each of which has a chance to [[drop]] as many as three items, including [[unique item]]s, randomly selected from a list of 15 unique items.

==Notes==
* Strategy: After killing the two [[Chaos Wurm]]s, head to the left side and kill the [[popup]]s (there is no need to go to the right side (unless [[farming]] for [[Glob of Ectoplasm|ecto]])). From the left side stairway, [[target]] the nearest [[Terrorweb Dryder]] and [[pull]] with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break [[aggro]] and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they ''cannot'' be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that [[Soloing|solo]] farm the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]].

== Trivia ==

* The Darkness was also part of some of the missions that took place during the first [[Dragon Festival]]s. Since that time, they have been replaced by [[The Darkness (actor)|actors]] recreating those historical events.
** During [[Dragon Festival 2006]] and [[Dragon Festival 2007|2007]], they appeared during the [[Tsumei Village (mission 2)|Tsumei Village second mission]].
** During the 2006 event, they also appeared in the [[Seitung Harbor (mission 2)|Seitung Harbor second mission]].

*The Darkness's name, along with the Ogre-Slaying Knife it can drop, is likely a reference to the 1996 Dead Alewives comedy sketch "Dungeons and Dragons" (also known as "Summoner Geeks"), in which a player boasts his knife does "+9 against ogres!" while another repeatedly shouts "I'm attacking the darkness!"
